 'sin': lambda p: p[0]/P + p[1]*P + p[2]*np.sin(p[4]*t)*P*(1-P/p[3]),
 'cos': lambda p: p[0]/P + p[1]*P + p[2]*np.cos(p[4]*t)*P*(1-P/p[3]),
 'lin': lambda p: p[0]/P + p[1]*P + p[2]*(t+p[4])*P*(1-P/p[3]),
 'lin2': lambda p: p[0]/P + p[1]*P + p[2]*t*P*(1-P/p[3]) + p[4]*t,
 'tP2': lambda p: p[0]/P + p[1]*P + p[2]*t*P*P + p[3]*t*P + p[4]*P*P,
}

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=np.asarray(df['t']);P=np.asarray(df['P']);y=np.asarray(df['dP_dt'])
forms={
 'P2/(1+dt)': lambda p: p[0]/P+p[1]*P+p[2]*P*P/(1+p[3]*t),
 'P2*exp(dt)': lambda p: p[0]/P+p[1]*P+p[2]*P*P*np.exp(p[3]*t),
 'P2/(1+dt)+t': lambda p: p[0]/P+p[1]*P+p[2]*P*P/(1+p[3]*t)+p[4]*t,
 'P2/(1+dt+et2)': lambda p: p[0]/P+p[1]*P+p[2]*P*P/(1+p[3]*t+p[4]*t*t),
 'tP/(1+P)': lambda p: p[0]/P+p[1]*P+p[2]*t*P/(1+p[3]*P),
 'P2/(1+dP)*t': lambda p: p[0]/P+p[1]*P+p[2]*t*P*P/(1+p[3]*P),
 'sinP': lambda p: p[0]/P+p[1]*P+p[2]*np.sin(p[3]*t)*P*P+p[4]*t*P,
}
for k,f in forms.items():
    best=None
    for s in range(40):
        p0=np.random.RandomState(s).uniform(-1.5,1.5,5)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, p0)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    print(k, round(np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(y),7), np.round(best.x,4))
